sources.title: CivArchive - CivitAI Archive
sources.snippet: About CivArchive CivArchive is a cross-platform search engine for AI models. We don't host files ourselves — instead, we crawl various sources and index the models we find, using the file's SHA256 hash as its unique, permanent ID. CivArchive was created in direct response to models being suddenly removed from CivitAI.
